same_law.key_value: Up to $1,000 civil penalty per violation; each month and each property is a separate violation
same_law.reason: All three cards cite S.D. Mun. Code § 98.1103 (§§ 98.1101-98.1104), the ban on algorithmic rent-setting devices. r-0087 is the draft ordinance version, r-0089 is the adopted text (O-21955 N.S., effective 2025-06-21), and r-0088 is a law-firm summary of the same section. The $1,000 per-violation penalty is the same on all three.
